content.title: Nukkleus, Mandragola establish joint venture for infrastructure modernization
content.summary: Nukkleus (NUKK), together with Mandragola announced the establishment of a strategic joint venture focused on commercial and defense-oriented infrastructure modernization. Under the new venture, Nukkleus and Mandragola intend to establish advanced manufacturing zones in both the Baltics and Israel, designed to support civil and defense aviation needs.
